method: Real persistent ledger, layer0, k8 recompute, TINY heads8/HBM1 stripe2. Token counts are modeled K token rows scanned, not DRAM rows/ACT/time. Each request weighted once, no live current-output tokens. Per-scan optimum freely relocates whole master blocks for that one readset, diffs pinned at slot1; optimistic bound, not a globally realizable table.
